data.title: Meridian appoints a Director of Digital Systems
data.excerpt: The role brings industrial software, integration, and data practice under one accountable leader.
data.body:
Meridian has appointed Marcus Chen as Director of Digital Systems, a role created to connect industrial software, integration, and data engineering under one practice.

คุณ Chen joins from the company's systems integration group and will lead the digital systems practice across the Bangkok and Rayong teams. The appointment is part of a broader operating model change intended to shorten the distance between strategy and delivery.

This is illustrative portfolio content; the person and appointment are fictional.
